lines.en: : AN ANGEL HAS GRACED US WITH HER PRESENCE! WE ARE BLESSED ON THIS JOYOUS DAY!
: Uhh...why has that strange girl from the beach suddenly returned? And why does it seem like Chika is about to abduct her?
: Because I am! Just look at her little ears! She’s even cuter than normal, which is already well beyond the limits of cuteness itself!
: Yeah. Cool. That’s all well and good and whatnot, but how the hell did she get here? Ayane’s place is a little too off the beaten path for stragglers to wander in, isn’t it?
: Is that...the mug girl?
: It sure is. But where is her mothermom?
: Her what?
: Kaori. Sorry. Associating with her has melted the part of my brain that assigns the correct words to the correct things.
: Nao-chan, what are you doing here? Did someone invite you? Did you finally decide to let me adopt you? Oh my God, you and Chinami are going to have so much fun together!
: Are you sure? Because I promise I can give you everything you would ever want for the rest of your life and promise to protect you forever and ever.
: Today, we witness the birth of a broodmother.
: No, Chika just loves kids. And...I will reluctantly admit that this one is kind of adorable.
: I want to pet her, but I think I’d go to jail.
: What’d you say her name was? Nao?
: Right! She loves mugs and has an impeccable taste in fashion. She is my child and anyone who tries to take her from me will suffer the-
: Nao-chan?
Our eyes meet from across the room — but not in the way they would if this was a movie.
There’s no romance or desire or even an inkling of wanting to be in one another’s company. She still confuses me. She still scares me.
And from her perspective, I’m sure the opposite’s true as well.
All that gaze tells me is that she’s looking for me. But I’m not sure why and...I’m not sure it will be possible for me to understand or find out based on the way she is.
She opens her mouth as if she’s going to speak. As always, though, no words come out. And even if they did, I doubt I’d hear them from my ship in this sea of temptation.
: I think she’s trying to call you over, Sensei.
: This...seems off. The guards aren’t supposed to open the gate for anyone outside of our class. How did she get in?
I reluctantly wave to Nao-chan and-
And it’s not enough to push her away.
: Hah...
: I’ll be right back, I guess.
: No, wait. I’ll come with you.
: Fine.
: Having one more person there to try and translate her silence might prove helpful since I still can’t ever figure out what she’s trying to say...
: Can we keep her, Sensei? Pleeeeeease?
: Did you...just want to say hi, Nao? I’m kind of busy right now.
: Did someone let you in here, Nao-chan? And did you...happen to see any other girls our age when you got through the gate?
: I’m thinking maybe she snuck in behind Ami or Maya or something and-
: Wow, so can she really just not make any noise at all? Or...
: She doesn’t need to. Nao-chan can not be heard, only understood. And what she’s trying to tell us now is that she didn’t see Ami or Maya! So yeah, good news all around.
: Well...what brings you here then?
: Sensei? Why?
: Did you miss your father, Nao-chan? Did you just want to show him your cute little kitty costume?
: Uhh...do you understand her enough to make any sense of that, Chika?
: I’m not really sure. All I’m getting is a bunch of nonsense. But whatever it is, it seems urgent.
: You want to...go outside with Sensei? How come?
: Yeah, what? Doesn’t Kaori normally give you some kind of note in situations like this?
: Ooooh, right. This is a Kaori thing. That...makes slightly more sense.
: I think...she’s saying that Kaori might be in trouble.
: Or not.
: You need me to come with you, though?
: Well, how long will it take? Because my...daughter-slash-niece is probably on the way and I don’t really want her to be here without me tonight.
: How about I come instead, Nao-chan? Maybe I can help?
: Yeah...I think I’d like to come too. Something seems weird about this.
: Something seems weird about literally everything she’s involved with. And you’re the first person to see things the same way.
: Which is even more of a reason why-
: Just me?
: If that is what Nao-chan wants, it is what Nao-chan will get.
: Sensei-
: I know. But what choice do I have?
: The choice to ignore her and stay here. We have no idea when the next thing will happen. And I’ve got a really weird gut-feeling about this.
: Like, her just being here is weird enough. But for it to be something that only you can help with-
: I’ll call you. Don’t worry. Just...look after Ami when she gets here since Chika sure as hell can’t be trusted with that.
: I’m slightly less inclined to tear her to shreds now that I understand that there are different ways love can manifest and that she isn’t a threat to me. But yeah, fair.
: What?
: So...where to, Nao?
Nao easily breaks free from the grip Chika has on her arm and darts toward the door, leaving me nothing to do but chase after her.
Ayane is right, though. Something seems really off about-
blah blah blah. who gives a shit? this is clearly your chance to fuck her.
Oh good. And here I was thinking I’d be able to enjoy a holiday without you.
yeah, i’ve been a little busy.
but hey, i left you alone during the beach, didn’t i? like, maybe not the whole time, but still. i respect your privacy. that’s what friends are for.
We aren’t friends.
friends, pals, buddies, partners, whatever you want to call us. the fact remains that you’re getting booty-called by a little girl dressed as a cat.
she’s probably just in heat and you’re the only one with the right tool for the job.
like seriously, though. isn’t it crazy how few men there are around here?
Leave me-
it’s simple as shit, akira. stick it in, wiggle it around a little, and get back to the party. you’re not going to want to miss it this year. but you don’t want to miss this either, so-
How do you know I won’t want to miss this party?
because i’m a fucking god or something, right? how else would i be able to make a little bitch like you see and hear and do a whole bunch of really cool stuff?
god, i hope you’re getting all quiet now because you’re actually thinking about taking a leap of faith for once.
Do you know who this girl is? How she got here?
Do you know anything?
Why are you the one being quiet now?
because even gods get lost sometimes, fucker.
i don’t have all the answers. like, i obviously have more than you. but my knowledge is nowhere near as vast as i want it to be.
and that thing lies beyond the boundaries of it.
but man does it look like it’d be fun to FUCK.
I manage to shut it out again — that nagging voice in the back of my head that may or may not just be a get out of jail free card.
It’s dark once we make it outside. I didn’t realize how much time had passed.
I feel like I just got here, and yet...I’m already leaving.
But maybe that’s for the best considering the last time I went to a Halloween party, I wound up having earth-shattering sex on top of the school roof.
If that happens again this year, no matter who it happens with, I wonder if I’ll close my eyes and pretend it’s her.
But an even more pressing question is whether or not I’ll even want to.
: Now what? Can’t you at least try and sign to me where we’re going or...something?
: Nao, I can’t understand you. And I get that you might think that this is some sort of emergency. But wouldn’t it make sense to at least carry around notes for stuff like this?
: Fine...whatever. Just go then. But wherever we’re going better not be far since I am not about to walk ten miles with a small child in tow.
: What? I-
So-
It appears I won’t be walking at all...
Aboard the back of a giant chicken, I have some time to think of a few things.
The first is that this should probably feel a little stranger to me than it actually does.
The second is that I haven’t heard John’s voice in quite some time.
I wonder if I’ve just lost the ability to?
Come to think of it, I haven’t spoken to Noodles in a while either.
If I’ve ever really spoken to him in the first place and haven’t just been having auditory hallucinations to pair with all of my visual ones.
But, if that’s the case, why can’t I do that with Nao?
Why are birds easier to speak to and understand than this potentially human child?
That voice in the back of my head is supposed to know everything. But if it can’t even fathom her, isn’t it insane to board a giant chicken with her in the first place?
Perhaps we’ll ride right into the mouth of hell. Perhaps she’ll drink my blood and liquefy my insides with some kind of invisible proboscis.
Or maybe her intentions mirror that innocent smile she sports each time I see her.
It must be nice having not figured out how terrible this place is yet.
I wonder if I was ever able to smile like that? Or if this tragedy extends so far back that my world-view was tainted before it ever had the chance to form.
Another thing I think of on the back of this chicken is that spreading this disease does nothing to cure my case of it.
I’m even more dangerous than she is, aren’t I? Even if she is an eldritch horror.
Which raises the question — what do you find scarier?
Monsters pretending to be humans? Or humans pretending to be humans?
Because one of those things is inherently harmful. The other is misunderstood.
: Are you having fun?
: Yeah...I thought so.
: If only John would speak to me. Maybe then he could translate.
: BACAWK!
As expected. I’ve lost touch with even the make-believe at this point.
: Nao...just out of curiosity...
: Is there actually a problem at all? Or did you just...feel the need to get me away from that party to protect me?
: Don’t worry about it. Just some wishful thinking on my end.
: Last Halloween...didn’t go so great. So I think that part of me might be kind of thankful you showed up.
: Unless this is an actual emergency, that is. Because if this chicken comes to a halt near Kaori’s dead body or something, I’m going to be pretty bummed.
: Sorry. I’m sure she’s fine. I just tend to always think the worst. And that’s been way more true lately than ever before on account of...
: Well...
: Me being an asshole is the polite way to put it, I guess.
: It’s fine. You don’t have to pretend I’m not.
: I just ask that, if you plan on eating me, to start from the head and work your way down. The sooner I’m gone, the better.
: Too morbid?
: Sorry.
: I’ll try to snap out of it by the time we make it to our destination.
: Wherever that may be...
